turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My wife, do not worry about such things. We will make sure our son is well taken care of and that the poor fool is cared for as well. You have done enough, and I will see to it that your wishes are fulfilled.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, take my hand and promise me that you will care for your father and the poor fool as if they were me. I cannot bear the thought of leaving them without a mother.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I promise to care for Father and the poor fool as if they were you. Please don't worry, I will do my best to fulfill your wishes.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you will, my son. Now, my daughter, can you promise me that you will support your husband and care for the poor fool as if she were your own kin?

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will do my best, mother-in-law. I promise to support my husband and care for the poor fool as if she were my own kin.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, my daughter. Now, I must ask you all to prepare for my passing. I want to see my son married before I go, and I need you to help me make this happen.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dearest O-lan, do not worry. We will see to it that our son is married and you will rest in peace knowing all is well. I will take care of everything and ensure your last wishes are fulfilled.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am grateful, my husband and daughter. Now, we must act swiftly. Find a suitable match for my son and arrange the wedding without delay.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will see to it immediately, my love. Rest assured, your wish will be granted.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My heart is heavy, but I trust you, Wang Lung, to choose wisely for our son. Let us not delay any longer.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I shall find a match worthy of our son and arrange the wedding at once. Do not trouble yourself, my love, for I will see to it personally.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, please do not worry. Father will take care of everything, and I will do my best to make you proud. I am here for you.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I thank you, my son, for your words. Now, let us not waste time. We must find a bride for you soon, Wang Lung, so that my heart may rest.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will cooperate fully. Please rest and focus on getting well.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, rest assured. I will find the most suitable match for our son and ensure the wedding is arranged swiftly. Your wishes will be fulfilled.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Father, I am ready to help in any way I can. Mother, please try to rest and focus on healing.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will ensure that all arrangements are made swiftly and to your satisfaction, Master Wang Lung, and I will assist Lady O-lan with anything she needs.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: My dear, do not worry. We will see to it that all is well. Our son will be married, and you will see your wish come true.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, all of you. I must see this through with all my strength. Wang Lung, ensure the wedding is arranged without delay.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will make sure everything is ready, my love. Rest now, and let us focus on your healing.

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: Die I must, [GE-OMITTED:5:aa] [GE-OMITTED:6:aa] and well she serves me, [GE-OMITTED:7:aa] [GE-OMITTED:8:aa] because I must die, [GE-OMITTED:9:aa] [GE-OMITTED:10:aa] [GE-OMITTED:11:aa]

opening.speaker: O-lan
opening.text: [GE-OMITTED:40:aa] My son, [GE-OMITTED:41:aa] and my daughter, [GE-OMITTED:42:aa] there is she. [GE-OMITTED:43:aa]
